body:
## Status: FILE ONLY / UNROUTED
Guy authorized redesign scoping and issue filing, not dispatch, implementation, fleet resume, PR, merge or release. No labels or assignees. Visual implementation requires approved prototype evidence and separate routing approval.

## Preserved contract
Accepted V1 panorama + R2 ranch environment + original V1 horse design and corrected grazing anatomy. Native procedural SwiftUI Canvas/Path with distinct/exportable layers; no flattened raster scene, video backdrop, WebView, new engine or service dependency. Same authoritative live model, filters, composite identities, blocked rail and Recent Output destination. Preserve truthful offline/unknown states and accessible operation. Day/Night/Auto environment remains independent of the app's Catppuccin preference. No daemon, SSE, pairing, grant, APNs or release work.

## Design dependency
Refs #455 — owner-selected contract and visual gate. Depends on approved prototype/spec, plus explicit routing. Refs #442/#444; do not duplicate gait #448 or repository ordering #449.

## Owner-selected behavior
Settings controls the saved mode and applies immediately; remove the prominent top Board/Herd switch; retain Open Board recovery action. Add a native Board/Herd choice under Appearance or the adjacent existing Herd settings grouping, with clear selected state and explanation that it is saved.

## Source / scope
AppModel.swift fleetPresentation currently initializes to .board in memory. HerdModel.swift:5 defines FleetPresentation. FleetViews.swift:957-970 owns the principal switch; SettingsView:3071-3073 owns Appearance/Herd settings. Own preference persistence and Settings UI plus removal of that switch; no scene-art or filter rewrite.

## Proposed edge semantics for design confirmation
No saved value -> Board (preserves existing launch behavior); unknown stored value -> safe Board fallback. Open Board recovery temporarily overrides current presentation without changing saved preference; a later explicit Settings selection wins immediately. Foregrounding alone must not unexpectedly reverse a temporary recovery override. Relauch restores saved preference. These defaults must be explicit in approved prototype/spec.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Selecting Board or Herd in Settings updates current presentation immediately; dismissing Settings reveals it, and cold relaunch restores the saved value.
- [ ] One canonical persisted preference; test new install, upgrade without a value, invalid value, both selections and real persistence round-trip.
- [ ] Remove principal top mode switch without orphaning Settings; Settings remains reachable from both modes. Recovery Open Board remains accessible and does not silently rewrite default.
- [ ] Preserve live data, shared filters, selection and host identity across changes; no SSE restart/re-pair, duplicated subscriptions or storage of private scene data.
- [ ] Setup/unpaired and demo flows remain valid; test preference restoration without bypassing setup or leaking demo data into live mode.
- [ ] Actual-app interaction evidence exercises Settings -> Herd/Board -> dismissal -> relaunch, not setter-only tests. Include Dynamic Type and VoiceOver selected state; native/CI gates pass.

## Integration boundary
Coordinate top-switch removal with shell owner; separate reviewable patch, not a duplicate shell rewrite. No last-used-mode algorithm or extra quick-switch menu.
title: iOS Settings: persist Board/Herd mode and remove the top mode switch
